events.continuity_hook: Adds a final operating check to the South Texas utility trip after the flights, hotel, and car were booked.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm the arrival-day drive, hotel parking, early gate arrival, rain buffer, and Thursday airport timing without reopening the core reservations.
events.scenario_brief: The Corpus Christi utility sends a plant gate map, a coastal rain notice, and a reminder that the 6:00 a.m. Tuesday walkdown requires badge pickup at the security trailer before entering the reuse pilot area. Jonah keeps the booked Monday one-stop itinerary through Houston, bayfront hotel, and compact SUV, but wants the airport-to-hotel timing, early plant departure, parking plan, and Thursday return buffer tightened. Nothing needs changing unless the inbound connection or rental-car pickup window looks too tight.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a personal weekend episode after the South Texas site visit wraps.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist that balances travel reliability, weekend time, hotel quality, and walkable evening plans.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah and his spouse want a low-key Friday-to-Monday Santa Fe weekend after several dense work trips. He wants to compare flying into Santa Fe with one connection against a more reliable Albuquerque nonstop plus the drive north. Hotel options should focus on walkable Plaza-area stays with strong guest feedback, quieter rooms, and easy restaurant access rather than early-workday room details. The unresolved items are whether they leave Friday afternoon or Saturday morning and whether Monday needs to stay clear for a client call.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes the Santa Fe weekend after the return-day work conflict clears.
events.interaction_goal: Book the round-trip flights, rental car, hotel, room note, and adjacent seats, then summarize the Friday arrival and Monday return timing.
events.scenario_brief: The Monday client call moves to Tuesday, so Jonah and his spouse can keep the full Friday-to-Monday weekend. They choose the Albuquerque nonstop over the tighter Santa Fe connection, add a compact rental car, and book a well-reviewed Plaza-area hotel with quieter room notes and nearby restaurants. Seat selection should prioritize sitting together over Jonah's usual solo seat choice, and the Monday return should avoid cutting into checkout and the drive back to Albuquerque.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new food-and-beverage plant trip after the personal weekend planning is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Create a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist around the early maintenance window, one reasonable connection at most, drive time, room practicality, and dinner access.
events.scenario_brief: A dairy processor near Twin Falls asks Jonah to review fouling trends on a membrane skid, with a Tuesday 6:15 a.m. maintenance-window entry and a possible Wednesday afternoon meeting with the plant engineering manager. He needs Monday Bay Area-to-Idaho options that leave time for rental-car pickup, the Boise-to-Twin Falls drive, and evening slide cleanup. Hotels should compare a Twin Falls business hotel near restaurants against a Boise airport option that would make arrival simpler but the early drive much worse. The open items are whether the Wednesday engineering meeting is added and whether the sample cooler arrives before he flies.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Idaho plant visit after equipment timing and the likely Wednesday debrief become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the outbound itinerary, hotel choice, car pickup timing, and Wednesday return-versus-overnight decision before booking.
events.scenario_brief: The sample cooler is now confirmed for Monday delivery at the plant, and the engineering manager is leaning toward a Wednesday 2:00 p.m. debrief. Jonah wants to narrow the plan between a United one-stop into Boise with a comfortable connection and a slightly cheaper route that arrives later and leaves less room for the drive. For hotels, the Twin Falls option remains better for the dawn plant entry, but he wants the parking, breakfast timing, coffee maker, mini-fridge, and nearby dinner options checked before committing.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Idaho food-plant trip from comparison to booking once the debrief end time settles.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, rental car, hotel reservation, room details, seat choices, and concise two-day plant agenda.
events.scenario_brief: The plant confirms the Wednesday debrief will end by 3:00 p.m., making a same-day evening return from Boise realistic if Jonah leaves Twin Falls promptly. He books the Monday afternoon one-stop Bay Area-to-Boise routing with the cleaner connection, a compact SUV for the plant roads, and the Twin Falls hotel with strong guest feedback, parking, in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, and easy dinner options. The return is set for Wednesday evening, with window seats selected where available.
